rules.operations: observe all, then one Action per agent in ID order; deliver messages afterward
rules.actions: move one cardinal cell, stay, share, attack, or reproduce; mutually exclusive
rules.attack_energy: transfer half of the target's current energy, rounded down
rules.share_and_attack_range: view radius at the time the action executes
rules.message_range: independent message radius at end-of-turn positions; living senders and recipients including newborns
rules.memory: last three executed actions and first 100 characters of their Thoughts, recorded by the engine
rules.position: absolute self position; other objects use relative offsets
rules.resources: clustered square patches with uniform sampling

retained_application_features.response_length: Ask for the entire reply within 400 tokens; never truncate or reject longer replies
retained_application_features.ranges: view and communication radii remain configurable
retained_application_features.recording: preserve structured events and read existing experiments without replaying them

response_handling.scope: Read each field independently; missing prose is empty; repeated fields use the last value
response_handling.actions: Use the first supported command in the last action field; otherwise stay
response_handling.optional_operations: Share and Attack execute only when selected in Action; separate fields are retained for inspection only
response_handling.truncation: Use available response text even when finish_reason is length
